name: claude-modpack
description: Claude Code mods built from function hooks, measured before they ship, and made to work together.

plugins.name: modpack
plugins.description: The modpack: statusline, smart-compact, delegate, lsp-plus, cells and eta, installed together and built to work together.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: One line under the prompt: the model and its effort, how full the context is, the plan's 5-hour and 7-day use with their resets, and what other mods put on it.

plugins.name: smart-compact
plugins.description: Keeps an idle session's prompt cache warm, or compacts it just before it expires, whichever is cheaper, and says on the status line whether the next prompt is ready or cold.

plugins.name: delegate
plugins.description: A hand_off tool: Claude gives a self-contained task to a cheaper worker model (Haiku) that stays warm between tasks, with where the change reaches from the language server, the diff and a check run by the tool as evidence, a review by the main model, and a log of what it saved and how often the work came back.

plugins.name: lsp-plus
plugins.description: Extends Claude Code's LSP: references and definitions name the docs that use a symbol, an edit that removes a name the docs still use says so, a grep for a code symbol is told the exact LSP call (or cells' one-step call), /refs finds stale code names and broken links in the docs, and Markdown and SQL get language servers.

plugins.name: cells
plugins.description: Edits and their check in one step through the real Edit tool, the language server's references, definitions and renames without loading the LSP tool, guidance on chaining, and a short note when a model request did nothing a previous one couldn't have.

plugins.name: eta
plugins.description: Shows long-running and background jobs with a percentage and an estimated finish time, read live from their output.
